kypExtensions.summary: KYP-authored exam-strategy synthesis (vignette patterns, classic confusions, look-alike pivots, mini-case with answer autopsy) built on top of the cited First Aid page — the facts are source-verified, the strategic framing itself is original KYP pedagogy.

kypExtensions.summary: The mechanistic explanation of why the lagging strand's final RNA primer cannot be replaced (no upstream 3′-OH to extend), which is why linear chromosome ends shorten — First Aid states telomerase prevents 'loss of genetic material with every duplication' but does not spell out the primer-removal cause.
kypExtensions.rationale: Genuinely difficult concept (why telomerase is needed at all); the standard molecular-biology explanation deepens the source's one-line rationale without contradicting it.
